title: Not All Experience Belongs in the Weights: Component Routing for Self-Improving GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.01787v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-improving GUI agents keep the trajectories they produce and return them to the agent, by fine-tuning or by retrieval into the prompt, and studies that compare the two destinations disagree. We attribute this to the unit of experience: a trajectory bundles items with different properties, so a conclusion about the bundle depends on its mix. To address this, (i) we introduce component routing, which splits the experience into locators, procedures, state facts and lessons and sends each component to the context or to the weights, compared on the same items across three backbone families, two environments and three seeds. One pool has two destinations: locators and lessons win in the weights, procedures and state facts in the context. translated_title: 并非所有经验都应写入权重：面向自我改进GUI智能体的组件路由
translated_abstract: 自我改进的GUI智能体会保留其生成的轨迹，并通过微调或检索入提示词的方式将其返回给智能体，而比较这两种去向的研究结论并不一致。我们将此归因于经验的单位：一条轨迹捆绑了具有不同属性的项目，因此关于该捆绑包的结论取决于其组成成分。为解决这一问题，（i）我们提出了组件路由（component routing），将经验拆分为定位器、操作流程、状态事实和经验教训，并将每个组件分别送入上下文或权重中，在三个骨干模型系列、两个环境和三个随机种子上对相同项目进行比较。同一个经验池有两个去向：定位器和经验教训在权重中胜出，操作流程和状态事实则在上下文中更优。（ii）我们在任何训练开始前测量的两个属性——重复性和状态条件性——上拟合出一条规则；该规则在24个测试单元格中全部正确恢复了一个留出骨干系列的去向，两项干预措施……
tldr: 提出组件路由方法，将GUI智能体的经验拆分为定位器、操作流程、状态事实和经验教训四类组件，并依据训练前即可测量的重复性和状态条件性两个属性，决定各组件应存入模型权重还是上下文，从而统一解释了微调与检索两种经验去向的争议。
en_tdlr: Component routing splits GUI agent experience into locators, procedures, state facts, and lessons, routing each component to either model weights or context based on two pre-training properties (recurrence and state-conditionality), thereby resolving the disagreement over whether fine-tuning or retrieval is the better destination for self-improvement.
